claim: OpenClaw Gateway critical configuration resolved: (1) PT_DIR properly set in workspace+system, (2) all services running (PT:8000, orama:8001, Portal:8002), (3) GLM-5.2 API key configured with BigModel endpoint, (4) start.sh symlinked from orama-system to workspace. Deployment verified operational.
conditions: start.sh symlink from orama-system to workspace,

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04 final deployment exposed 4 critical configuration areas that required coordination between orama-system and workspace. Gateway now reports all systems UP. This lesson ensures future deployments and debugging know exact configuration points: PT_DIR resolution (multiple paths), service port binding (all three must be accessible), GLM-5.2 integration (secrets + endpoint), workspace initialization (symlink strategy). Resolution verified by gateway status output.
